wants.topic: Maa Durga & Mahakali High-Action Demon Battles (Mahishasur, Raktabeej, Shumbh-Nishumbh Vadh)
wants.evidence: Daksh Cinematics' 'Mahakali vs Raktabeej' (1649.6x vsNormal) and 'Maa Durga vs Shumbh Nishumbh' (1345.65x vsNormal); KATHA SAGAR's 'Mahisasur Vadh' (4.8M views).

wants.topic: Divine Domestic Intervention: Maa Durga doing household chores / testing poor devotees (Adhaiya, Sugandha, Chanda)
wants.evidence: GuruVaani Studio's 'Maa Durga se aakhir kyon boodhi aurat ne karwaya kaam' (584.21x vsNormal) and 'Chanda ne kyon uthai jharoo' (108.13x vsNormal); JagaLeela Studio & Rasiya Films' Adhaiya series.

wants.topic: Origin Stories & Untold Leelas of Major Deities (How Ganesha got his trunk, Vaishno Devi & Bhaironath)
wants.evidence: KATHA SAGAR's 'Ganesh Ji ke Gajanan banne ki adbhut katha' (33.3M views, 6.92x vsNormal); Rasiya Films' 'Maa Vaishno Devi vs Bhaironath' (91.62x vsNormal).

wants.topic: Folk Character Crossovers & Lighthearted Devotion (Adhaiya interacting with Shri Ram, Hanuman, Durga)
wants.evidence: Rasiya Films' 'Adhaiya ki Diwali with Shri Ram & Hanuman' (34.08x vsNormal); JagaLeela Studio's Adhaiya series (11x–13x vsNormal consistently).

gaps: High-stakes cinematic breakdown of specific Devi Mahatmya chapters beyond basic Durga battles.
Emotional storytelling linking real-life domestic hardships (mistreatment by relatives, poverty) directly with authentic mythological miracles rather than generic preachy morals.
Engaging animated narratives focusing on Bal Krishna leelas with high visual action.
saturated: Generic overview of Dashavatars of Lord Vishnu without a specific character angle.
Overdone basic myths like Hanuman eating the Sun or Bheem vs Hanuman.
Modern non-mythological moral dramas (e.g., DM wife/husband stories) uploaded on Bhakti channels.
Audio Bhajans/Songs posted on story-driven animation channels.
Dry ritual explainers (e.g., Pitru Paksha rules) lacking narrative character arcs.
